To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the optimal throughput performance of the proposed network is achieved when the two phases have equal durations, the throughput performance depends only on the total buffer capacity and the suboptimal scheme performs close to the optimal.
the throughput performance of a buffer aided successive relaying network employing energy harvesting depends on the total data buffer capacity and not the smallest data buffer capacity.

(1) The throughput performance of the suboptimal scheme is very close to that of the optimal one; (2) The throughput performance depends on both data and energy buffers, and not just on their smallest capacity; (3) The suboptimal and optimal schemes achieve up to 88% and 92% of the benchmark scheme performance, respectively.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the design of an EH assisted successive relaying network that maximizes the network throughput, and the results obtained are useful for future energy efficient and sustainable wireless communication networks.
the design of an efficient energy harvesting based successive relaying network, where the source and the relay nodes have finite energy and data buffer capacities, respectively.
the throughput maximization of a rechargeable successive relaying network employing energy harvesting, and the results obtained are useful to the design of EH-assisted wireless networks.

the optimal and suboptimum schemes are capable of approaching the throughput performance of an EH-assisted successive relaying network with a large data and energy storage buffer capacity.
for the considered network model, the proposed schemes are capable of providing a near optimal performance with a significantly low complexity.
the throughput performance of a buffer assisted successive relaying protocol employing EH nodes depends on both the data and energy buffers' sizes and the total buffer capacities available.

, for asymmetric data (or) energy buffer capacities, the total data (or) buffer capacity of the network is the main factor affecting the throughput performance.

the throughput performance of a buffer aided EH assisted network is significantly enhanced when the network employs the successive relaying based protocol.
a successive relaying protocol can be used to maximize the network throughput for the buffer aided energy harvesting networks.
